content.text: severe alkalosis (eg, pH > 7.6) sometimes needs more urgent correction; acetazolamide 250 to 375 mg PO or IV once or twice a day ↑ HCO3− excretion but may also ↑ urinary K+ and PO4− losses; volume-overloaded pts w diuretic-induced alkalosis and those w posthypercapnic alkalosis may especially benefit.

CI: hypersensitivity (a sulfonamide derivative: cross-sensitivity w sulfonamides possible); CI: ↓ Na and/or K, marked kidney or liver dz, adrenal failure, hyperchloremic acidosis, cirrhosis (hepatic encephalopathy risk). Rare fatal sulfonamide rxns (SJS/TEN, fulminant hepatic necrosis, agranulocytosis, aplastic anemia, anaphylaxis): stop at signs of hypersensitivity. Caution w high-dose aspirin (anorexia, tachypnea, lethargy, met acidosis, coma and death reported). Can cause hyponatremia, hypokalemia and metabolic acidosis: check lytes periodically. Baseline CBC and platelets, then at regular intervals.
